_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Craft Test Status Report
summary: The Craft Test Status Report provides periodic status of test performance or test documentation development to assist in assessing test program progress and identify potential problem areas.
use_relationship:
The Craft Status Report provides periodic status of test performance or test documentation development, to assist in assessing test program progress, and to identify potential problem areas.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task required as delineated in the contract.
b. This DID is related to DIDs DI-MISC-81621 and to DI-MISC-81622.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Test Status Report shall be presented in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Test Status Report shall include:

children.title: Introduction and Summary Narrative.
children.content: The Introduction and Summary Narrative shall contain an introduction to and an explanation of the report, major test program milestones completed since the last report, discussion of problems which may affect scheduled completion of the test program, and other pertinent remarks. It shall include the reason(s) why the test were not started or completed on schedule and impact of the test schedule, craft completion data, or both. Discussion of problems should refer to Test Change Proposals (TCP's) (DI-MISC-81621) and Test Problem Reports (TPR's) (DI-MISC-81622) whenever they are applicable.

children.title: Graphic Summary.
children.content: The Graphic Summary shall provide a graphic representation of planned and actual completion of tests, milestone events and documentation, and the type of report being prepared.

children.title: Report Body.
children.content: The Craft Test Status Report shall include the status of test conduct for all tests which will be performed at the contractor's facility or under his direction. Government test performance shall be included if they impact or could impact the completion of contractual requirements. The body of the report shall contain:

children.title: Total Number of tests to be accomplished.
Tests scheduled to complete but not completed.
Tests scheduled to start but not started.
Tests scheduled to start during the next reporting period.
Tests scheduled to complete during the next reporting period.
